note: Frozen test songs for the Apple Music UIA play experiment. 'artist' is what SMTC is expected to report (and what narrows search candidates); 'resolveArtist' is what the public iTunes Search API knows the catalog artist as (they differ when Apple Music credits a real name, e.g. Abel Tesfaye vs The Weeknd). 'url' is resolved once during discovery and frozen, so the stability runs need no network.

songs.title: 晴天
songs.note: Chinese song. Waiting for the Apple Music song URL copied from the user's own Apple Music app (Share -> Copy Link). The URL is the deterministic locating entry: the flow opens it (navigation only, never success), waits for the target row, realizes it and double clicks it, then verifies through SMTC. What was tried and rejected: itunes cn storefront search returns nothing / HTTP 400; the Apple Music web page is client-rendered with no /cn/song/ links in the HTML; the tw-storefront link is ignored by the app; the default storefront only surfaces cover versions.
